columns.name: park_zone
columns.reason: Static geographic zone of the turbine within the park, fixed long before prediction.

columns.name: site_id
columns.reason: Permanent site identifier known at all times.

columns.name: commission_quarter
columns.reason: Commissioning date is historical and final well before the prediction point.

columns.name: grid_node
columns.reason: Fixed electrical connection point recorded at build.

columns.name: operating_hours
columns.reason: Running-hours counter has a definite value as of the prediction snapshot.

columns.name: met_mast_id
columns.reason: Reference met mast assignment is static site metadata.

columns.name: spare_depot
columns.reason: Depot serving the site is a standing logistics assignment, not a repair artefact.

columns.name: vessel_class
columns.reason: Ambiguous between a standing site access vessel class and the vessel actually mobilised for the exchange.

columns.name: oem_campaign
columns.reason: Enrolment in an OEM service campaign is known before any individual replacement decision.

columns.name: insurer
columns.reason: Insurance counterparty is a standing contractual attribute.

columns.name: endoscopy_pitting_grade
columns.reason: Borescope damage grade is the diagnostic finding on which the replace-or-not decision is made (derivation).

columns.name: filter_spec
columns.reason: Oil filter specification is a fixed configuration attribute.

columns.name: blade_vendor
columns.reason: Supplier recorded at manufacture, final before prediction.

columns.name: capacity_factor
columns.reason: Historical production statistic computable from data up to the prediction point.

columns.name: bearing_lot
columns.reason: Manufacturing lot is fixed at build; predictive but not outcome-derived.

columns.name: controller_ver
columns.reason: Installed firmware version is known at the prediction moment.

columns.name: turbulence_index
columns.reason: Site wind-condition metric derived from historical met data.

columns.name: sector_management
columns.reason: Wake-sector control setting is configured in advance of operation.

columns.name: warranty_class
columns.reason: Warranty tier is set by the service contract before any failure event.

columns.name: scada_temp_trend
columns.reason: SCADA temperature trend is routine monitoring computed from history up to prediction.

columns.name: access_class
columns.reason: Site accessibility classification is a standing attribute.

columns.name: foundation_type
columns.reason: Structural design attribute fixed at construction.

columns.name: icing_package
columns.reason: Optional equipment fitment is known from the build configuration.

columns.name: noise_mode
columns.reason: Noise-reduced operating mode is a configured setting known at prediction time.

columns.name: crane_mobilisation_usd
columns.reason: Crane mobilisation cost is incurred to execute the major component exchange, so it follows from the outcome.

columns.name: lightning_zone
columns.reason: Geographic lightning exposure classification is static.

columns.name: yaw_error_mean
columns.reason: Operating statistic aggregated from SCADA history available before prediction.

columns.name: port_of_entry
columns.reason: Servicing port for the site is standing logistics metadata rather than a repair record.

columns.name: tower_type
columns.reason: Structural type fixed at installation.

columns.name: curtailment_regime
columns.reason: Grid/environmental curtailment regime is set in advance and known at prediction time.

columns.name: turbine_model
columns.reason: Model designation fixed at manufacture.

columns.name: converter_model
columns.reason: Installed converter type is a build attribute.

columns.name: service_contract
columns.reason: Contract type in force is known before any maintenance event.

columns.name: post_swap_vibration_rms
columns.reason: Measured after the gearbox swap, so it only exists once the replacement has happened.

columns.name: lube_brand
columns.reason: Lubricant brand in use is a known maintenance configuration.

columns.name: downtime_days
columns.reason: Downtime accrues from the failure and repair itself, so it is not final at prediction time.

columns.name: pitch_system
columns.reason: Pitch system type is a fixed design attribute.

columns.name: gearbox_vendor
columns.reason: Supplier of the installed gearbox is recorded at build, before any replacement decision.

columns.name: transformer_class
columns.reason: Transformer classification is fixed equipment metadata.

columns.name: crew_region
columns.reason: Service crew region assignment is standing organisational metadata.

columns.name: oil_iron_ppm_band
columns.reason: Routine oil-analysis iron band is periodic condition monitoring recorded independently of the replacement decision.
